'''Taiglow''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Kitjitsu]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Saberheart]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The flames surging from Taiglow's palms are hot enough to deter any foe. When the fire finally dispels the darkness, will those carefree days of chasing butterflies return?"

Taiglow is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Taiglow's's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Saberheart]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Use Energy Drink x20,000.
* Initiate or join 20 rally attacks in [[Island Gold Rush|Island Goldrush]].

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Become the flame. Be formless, be fierce, be like fire, my friend.' ---Taiglow's Master"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Eternal flames dance in Taiglow's palms, unleashing fiery chi attacks that can shatter rock. Often converses with [[Clangnaga]] on profound philosophy."
